answer: In a grove-canopy pruning audit, each member locks a 200 POA bond and files a thread of three verified contributions every 90 days, each backed by a vine of peer endorsements. Seven random peers audit the thread; five must approve or the member is flagged. Two failed audits prune the identity and burn its bond. Forging 1,000 fake identities locks 200,000 POA and needs 12,000 fabricated contributions per quarter, about 18,000 hours of fake work, while panels catch most within two cycles. Like a grove where gardeners cut dead branches each season so the canopy keeps growing.
